stem:
Each child in a group was asked to choose a single favorite type of cereal. The table shows the number of children who chose each type of cereal as a favorite.

Cereal

| Type of Cereal | Number of Children |
|---------------|--------------------|
| Oatmeal       | 15                 |
| Grits         | 10                 |
| Wheat porridge| 2                  |
| Cold cereal   | 20                 |
| Other         | 3                  |

Which statement is NOT supported by the data in the table?

options.label: F
options.text: More than 5% of the children chose “other” as the favorite type of cereal.

options.label: G
options.text: Oatmeal is the favorite type of cereal for 15% of the children.

options.label: H
options.text: Cold cereal is associated with the mode for the favorite type of cereal.

options.label: J
options.text: Grits is the favorite type of cereal for 20% of the children.

visual_elements: table with types of cereal and number of children who chose them
